text: Love isn't just finding the perfect person, but building a perfect bond with an imperfect soul.

Hate is a heavy anchor; letting it go allows your spirit to sail free.
Holding onto hate is like drinking poison and expecting the other person to suffer.

text: Dreams are the blueprints for a future only you can build.

Originality isn't about being first; it's about being authentically you.

Imitation borrows light; originality generates its own sun.

text: Every human life contains a potential, if that potential is not fulfilled, then that life was wasted.

text: The main thing is to be moved, to love, to hope, to tremble, to live.

text: You have to be odd to be number one.

text: When you're the first person whose beliefs are different from what everyone else believes, you're basically saying, 'I'm right, and everyone else is wrong.' That's a very unpleasant position to be in.

text: Follow your own star!

text: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.

text: What sets you apart can sometimes feel like a burden and it's not. And a lot of the time, it's what makes you great.

text: Trusting your individual uniqueness challenges you to lay yourself open.

text: The surest way to corrupt a youth is to instruct him to hold in higher esteem those who think alike than those who think differently.

text: Originality is seeing what everyone else has seen, and thinking what no one else has thought.
